summary: This is a Rule 13a-16 foreign private issuer 6-K filing in which ChowChow Cloud International Holdings Limited issued a 'no-news' press release under NYSE American Section 401(d) in response to unusual trading activity on June 8-9, 2026. The filing states that the company has been unable to determine the cause or whether corrective action is appropriate, and explicitly disclaims any material undisclosed development. There is no transaction, offer, or special situation; the registrant is simply complying with exchange requirements regarding unusual market action. No deal terms, recommendations, or structural details are present.
